title: Parti Québécois Wins Quebec Provincial Election, Promises Independence Referendum
detail: The Parti Québécois won the most seats in the Oct 5 Quebec election but fell short of a majority: about 59 of 127 seats (64 needed), on under 30% of the vote, so Paul St-Pierre Plamondon leads a minority government. Late Liberal and Conservative surges, both parties opposed to a separation vote, denied a majority. The PQ has pledged a referendum only after Donald Trump leaves office in January 2029. Figures are from election-night counts and may change.

media.caption: Parti Québécois wins Quebec provincial election, promising a referendum on independence from Canada
